rust_summary: the render hook point `native_hand_drawn(hand)`: the first-person hand is drawn (`HandDrawn`).
doc_summary:
the render hook point `native_hand_drawn(hand)`, after the first-person hand and held item are drawn, with the
frame's target, the hand's quads and its clip matrix (`HandDrawn`). Bundles need `"hooks": @API:hand_drawn@`.
